richiami.difetto: There has been an incident where a vehicle caught fire whilst parked and charging due to a problem with the charging unit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the thermistor fit an additional thermal cut out inside the charger and to replace the existing charger cover for one with fire retardant properties.
richiami.titolo: THERMISTER POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD WHEN CHARGING
